title: Identities, Not Pairs: Distribution-Free False-Accept Control for Embedding-Based Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.35277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embedding-based verification often calibrates a false-accept threshold from all impostor pairs among $m$ identities, although these pairs share identities. We characterize a worst-case limit: when hub identities score highly against a fraction $\rho$ of the population, a calibration-only threshold with marginal false-accept rate (FAR) at most $\alpha$ under every identity-exchangeable law reaches the hub score on hub-free calibration sets with probability at most $(m+2)\alpha/(2\rho)$. Uniformly accepting near that score at levels well below $\rho/m$ therefore requires trial information. We propose COVE, which ranks the trial pair among all $N=\binom{m+2}{2}$ pairs formed by augmenting the calibration units with the probe and reference. Under identity exchangeability, its marginal FAR is at most $\lfloor\alpha N\rfloor/N$, with first possible acceptance at $1/N=O(1/m^2)$. The rule also retains this guarantee with a fixed symmetric cohort

translated_title: 身份而非配对：基于嵌入的验证中无分布假设的错误接受控制
translated_abstract: 基于嵌入的验证系统通常从 m 个身份之间的所有冒名顶替配对中校准错误接受阈值，尽管这些配对共享身份。我们刻画了一个最坏情况下的极限：当“枢纽身份”（hub identities）对总体中比例为 ρ 的部分获得高分时，在所有身份可交换分布下边际错误接受率（FAR）至多为 α 的纯校准阈值，在无枢纽的校准集上达到枢纽得分的概率至多为 (m+2)α/(2ρ)。因此，要均匀地接受接近该得分的配对且水平远低于 ρ/m，就需要试验信息。我们提出 COVE 方法，它通过用探针和参考扩充校准单元，在形成的所有 N=C(m+2,2) 个配对中对试验配对进行排名。在身份可交换性下，其边际 FAR 至多为 ⌊αN⌋/N，首次可能的接受发生在 1/N=O(1/m²)。该规则在使用固定对称参照群时同样保持这一保证。
tldr: 该论文揭示了基于嵌入的验证中仅依赖校准集的错误接受阈值在存在“枢纽身份”时的最坏情况局限，并提出 COVE 方法，通过将试验配对置于由探针与参考扩充后的所有配对中进行排名，在无分布假设下实现 O(1/m²) 水平的错误接受率控制。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the worst-case failure of calibration-only false-accept thresholds under hub identities and proposes COVE, which achieves distribution-free false-accept control at the O(1/m²) level by ranking the trial pair among all pairs formed by augmenting calibration units with the probe and reference.
